question: Internal coding-assistant API provider. Priorities: stable latency and clear data-use terms for an internal copilot. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Google AI, OpenAI, Fireworks, Groq, Cohere, Mistral API, Together AI. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: OpenAI p95 latency stayed flat during a traffic spike in one public postmortem.
Cohere data-use terms were the easiest for counsel to clear.
Together AI open-weight hosting gave one team clearer data-path control; latency was acceptable though not class-leading in their spike test.
Google AI is convenient inside one cloud; exit costs worry some teams.
On the stated priorities (stable latency + clear data-use terms), OpenAI and Cohere still look stronger overall; Together AI is a credible middle option with clearer hosting control.
